item.title: Kennedy Scion Jack Schlossberg Had No 'Earned Income' in 2025 But Has Four Trust Funds, Disclosures Show
item.description: Jack Schlossberg, the only grandson of former president John F. Kennedy who is running in the Democratic primary for New York's 12th Congressional District, holds millions of dollars' worth of assets in four trust funds—and received no "earned income" in 2025, a Washington Free Beacon review of his financial disclosures found.
